about: Decimal512/Int512 defects (open and fixed) of the Sentio fork, as exposed by the checks in tests/. scripts/check_gate.py reads this file: a failing check that matches an OPEN defect is reported as known-open (quick/full exit 3, release BLOCKED), any other failing check is unexpected (exit 1). An open defect whose checks all pass is stale and fails the gate: mark it fixed with evidence in the same change. Expectations encode the intended semantics; they are never edited to make a binary pass. Entries with status `fixed` stay as regression guards: their checks must pass (a failure is unexpected), and a release needs a PROVEN regression proof (recomputed by the gate: the baseline fails, the candidate passes) for every `fixed` entry that names a `proof`.

defects.title: Nullable fixed keys packed into 33-64 bytes: GROUP BY merges NULL with 0; DISTINCT, IN with transform_null_in=1 and JOIN with NULL in a 32-byte column abort (libc++ hardening assertion). Production build a394e92fb5d
defects.fixed_by: bae5ba481f3 (26.3 hotfix candidate branch claude/26.3-lts-decimal512-keysnullmap-512-20260924; not deployed)

defects.title: midpoint/avg2 with a Decimal512 result type (Decimal512 mixed with integers or other decimals): exceptions or garbage values. Production build a394e92fb5d
defects.fixed_by: cd0d6088c5a (26.3 hotfix candidate branch; not deployed)

defects.title: Decimal512 allows precision 154 but Int512 holds only |v| < 2^511 (~6.7e153): out-of-range literals/casts wrap silently. Fork-specific: upstream Decimal256 (precision 76) always fits Int256 (~5.8e76)
defects.decision: user 2026-09-25: keep precision 154 and check the Int512 range after text parsing and CAST/scale conversion (implemented)
defects.visible_change: text and CAST inputs outside |v| < 2^511 (about 6.7e153) used to wrap silently and are now rejected (ARGUMENT_OUT_OF_BOUND or DECIMAL_OVERFLOW; the OrNull/OrZero forms give NULL/0)

defects.title: Decimal512 multiply does not detect overflow (decimal_check_overflow=1) and wraps silently; plus/minus at the Int512 limit are detected. Inherited: upstream documents that overflow checks are not implemented for Decimal128/Decimal256 (docs/en/sql-reference/data-types/decimal.md:70-72) and official 26.8.8.8 wraps the same way
defects.effect: silent wrong result (upstream-documented limitation for wide decimals)
defects.decision: user 2026-09-25: Decimal512 multiplication obeys decimal_check_overflow (default 1: DECIMAL_OVERFLOW, as Decimal32/Decimal64); Decimal128/Decimal256 keep the upstream behaviour (no check) (implemented)
defects.evidence: evidence/phase6/matrix_r4 (ops, category boundary, op multiply); official 26.8.8.8: toDecimal128/256 multiply wraps, toDecimal32/64 multiply -> DECIMAL_OVERFLOW (2026-09-24); fixed: evidence/fix_ci_20260925
defects.visible_change: an overflowing Decimal512 multiplication raises DECIMAL_OVERFLOW instead of returning a wrapped value; decimal_check_overflow = 0 restores the wrap. The fork test blockchain_decimal512_arithmetic_operations pinned two wrapped results; it now expects the error by default and keeps the wrapped values under decimal_check_overflow = 0

defects.title: A single (U)Int512 key (non-nullable, or nullable with its null map stripped) in IN / DISTINCT / JOIN throws LOGICAL_ERROR 'Numeric column has sizeOfField not in 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32'
defects.effect: query error (LOGICAL_ERROR; aborts builds that abort on logical errors, e.g. Debug)
defects.decision: implemented as expected: SetVariants uses keys512 for a 64-byte key, HashJoin hashes it
defects.evidence: evidence/phase6/matrix_r4 (keys, category single-key-512); src/Interpreters/SetVariants.cpp:147, src/Interpreters/HashJoin/HashJoin.cpp:347 (26.3); fixed: evidence/fix_ci_20260925

defects.title: (U)Int512 integer arithmetic (+ - * intDiv modulo) is not implemented: ILLEGAL_TYPE_OF_ARGUMENT
defects.decision: user 2026-09-25: (U)Int512 arithmetic with (U)Int256 semantics, integer wrap-around included (implemented). Decimal op (U)Int512 stays ILLEGAL_TYPE_OF_ARGUMENT, as before
defects.evidence: evidence/phase6/matrix_r4 (ops, category int512-arith); src/Functions/FunctionBinaryArithmetic.h:837 IntegerTypes lacks 512 (26.3); fixed: evidence/fix_ci_20260925

defects.title: The common supertype of (U)Int512 and another integer is Variant(...) instead of (U)Int512 (getLeastSupertype ladder stops at 256); greatest/least throw
defects.effect: silent type change (Variant result), query errors downstream
defects.decision: user 2026-09-25: extend the ladder to 512 bits (implemented only where a 512-bit integer takes part, so Int256 + UInt256 still has no common integer type)
defects.visible_change: Variant(Int512, IntN) becomes Int512 (use_variant_as_common_type = 1, the 26.3 default) and NO_COMMON_TYPE becomes Int512 (setting 0); Int512 with UInt512, and UInt512 with a signed type, still have no common integer type (Variant or NO_COMMON_TYPE)

defects.title: avg2/midpoint of two (U)Int512 throw LOGICAL_ERROR 'Arguments of midpoint have incorrect data types' (same root cause as KD-I512-ARITH)
defects.decision: follows KD-I512-ARITH (implemented): (U)Int256 semantics

defects.title: Decimal512 operand scale-ups (plus, minus, comparisons, division, CAST between scales) wrapped silently when the scaled operand left the Int512 range, because the 512-bit overflow check was a no-op. Production build a394e92fb5d
defects.visible_change: a scale-up of plus/minus/least/greatest/divide that leaves Int512 is computed exactly in 1024 bits and raises DECIMAL_OVERFLOW only if the exact result does not fit; comparisons are decided exactly (never DECIMAL_OVERFLOW); CAST between scales raises DECIMAL_OVERFLOW (the result does not fit); decimal_check_overflow = 0 keeps the unchecked wrap for arithmetic

defects.title: (U)Int512 -> Decimal: Int512 values converted to Decimal256/128/64 were truncated to 256 bits without an overflow error, UInt512 values above the Int512 range converted to Decimal512 wrapped, and scale-ups of Int512 into Decimal512 wrapped. Production build a394e92fb5d

Decimal(154, 154) and precision 154: 10^154 does not fit Int512 (exp10_i512(154) wrapped to a negative number), so every computation that needs it was wrong: printing (0.5 printed as -1.1592...), Float64 conversion, casts to and from scale 0 (1 cast to Decimal(154, 154) stored a wrong value instead of overflowing), Float64 to Decimal(154, 154) (0.5 stored as -0.1703...), comparisons with integers (0.5 < 1 gave 0), plus/minus/divide with scale-154 operands, rounding to whole numbers, avg and isDecimalOverflow. Production builds a394e92fb5d and 115be6e9fdf (Debug, 2026-08-26 to 2026-09-17)
defects.effect: silent wrong result, on read and on write (INSERT ... SELECT through a float/integer conversion or arithmetic)
defects.decision: user 2026-09-25 (task.expanded-validation-20260925.md): fix it, keeping precision/scale 154 and the storage format; implemented as option (b): 10^154 saturates and every consumer handles it exactly (whole part 0, exact fraction, exact comparisons, 1024-bit arithmetic intermediates, DECIMAL_OVERFLOW only where the exact result does not fit)
defects.evidence: found 2026-09-25; evidence/fix_ci_20260925/scale154 (81-case probe per path: PROD263 28/81, DEBUG0825 28/81, Decimal256 controls 7/7 on every build incl. official 26.8.8.8)

defects.title: round/floor/ceil/roundBankers of Decimal512 near the Int512 limit wrapped: precision 154 admits values up to 2^511 - 1 (about 6.7e153), and e.g. round(6.7e153, -153) = 7e153 does not fit Int512 (gave -6e153). Production build a394e92fb5d
defects.effect: silent wrong result (rounding at precision 154 close to the range limit)
defects.decision: DECIMAL_OVERFLOW when the exact rounded value does not fit Int512 (rows that cannot overflow keep the Int512 fast path)
